poses.caption: Hang from the bar with an overhand grip, arms straight and shoulders elevated.
Keep elbows straight while drawing shoulder blades down and back to lift the body slightly; lower slowly.

jobs.detail: SCAPULAR PULL-UP, TWO square panels, same adult and equipment, REAR three-quarter view so scapulae/neck/back visible. Standalone gray pull-up frame with full top horizontal bar and both vertical uprights contained in each panel, bar safely overhead. BOTH hands wrap bar overhand pronated palms facing AWAY from face, slightly wider shoulder width, closed thumbs. LEFT passive hang: both elbows fully STRAIGHT overhead, shoulders elevated toward ears, body hanging long with feet off floor. RIGHT active scapular depression: arms STILL COMPLETELY STRAIGHT, same hand height on bar, shoulders pull DOWN away from ears, chest/body rises only a few centimeters, feet slightly higher. This is NOT elbow-flexion pullup, chin stays far below bar. Same long body straight legs together and feet off floor, no jump or kneeswing. Shoulder elevation/depression difference visible in neck/shoulder distance, elbows 180 degrees BOTH. Primary lower TRAPEZIUS one soft diffuse blurred red patch on intact upper/mid BACK of black shirt, no lats/biceps highlight, full opaque fabric behind scapulae, no muscle lines through cloth. Fine exposed upper trapezius/neck, delts/arms/calf grayscale detail. No bench.

jobs.detail: SEATED SINGLE-LEG HAMSTRING STRETCH, ONE static full-body pose side three-quarter view. Sit on floor plain thin gray mat. Near leg extended straight ahead with knee straight, heel on floor, toes pointing up; other leg bent outward, its foot resting near inner thigh of straight leg. Hinge gently FORWARD FROM HIPS with LONG straight back, hands reaching toward toes of extended leg, relaxed neutral neck aligned spine, no rounded slumped shoulders, no forced pull. Hands may rest near ankle if toes not reached. All limbs anatomically connected, two legs visible, head hands shoes within margins. Primary HAMSTRINGS highlight: ONE soft diffuse smoothly blurred red patch on POSTERIOR thigh over fully opaque BLACK shorts, no exposed thigh anatomy through fabric. Gray anatomical detail on exposed arms and calf, red nowhere else. Keep broad fabric folds and full opaque shorts rear seat crotch. No equipment or bench.
